priority_items.title: FLASH: CCG-21585 rammed BFAR BRP Datu Magat Salamat off Palawan; no injuries; Chair silent
priority_items.summary: PCG: contact at 11:13 PHT (03:13 UTC) ~6.36 NM NNW Abad Santos Shoal / ~54 NM Palawan EEZ during fuel-subsidy run. Starboard railings/stanchions/deck damage; no injuries (ST/Reuters). PCG: deliberately rammed. CCG counter-claim: law enforcement near Sabina Shoal; PH altered course and cut across bow. Same hull grounded Thursday at Hasa-Hasa and refloated. No DFA protest, Palace, or emergency AMM at 08:00 UTC. Do not recycle 2025 Scarborough/DFA-protest items.

priority_items.title: Transboundary haze: SGP Unhealthy overnight then all-moderate at 16:00 SGT; MYS 34 unhealthy, Johan Setia 190; Zahid offer pending Prabowo
priority_items.summary: NEA 16:00 SGT 18 Sep 24h PSI all moderate N69/C87/W80/E71/S65 (vs 17 Sep cutoff C92/W87). Central Unhealthy 21:00–00:00 SGT peak C103; off from 01:00 C100. 1h PM2.5 only central Elevated (C58). haze.gov 11:11 AM 18 Sep / Alert Level 3; sitrep does not name Singapore. DOE APIMS last complete 15:00 MYT 68/68: 34 unhealthy, Johan Setia 190, Nilai 178, Kuching 176; 16:00 dump not in. School-close 200 not met. Zahid offered CL-415MP + 3 helos + 52 personnel, referred to Prabowo; no consent print. H20 opening no readout at cutoff.
